messages:
maya: Heads up — we need to push svc-routing 1.12.3 to prod during tonight's change window (03:00-04:00 UTC). Who can press?

sam: I'm oncall tonight, can press if I get JIT elevation and MFA wired.

jen: I can approve the JIT but I'm OOO after 02:30 UTC. @sam please ping me before you press. Also confirm runtime pin.

maya: We're pinning runtime `v2.4.1-quant` for this one. Commit: ab12f3c. Release notes: https://internal.releases/svc-routing/1.12.3 (small fixes + backpressure tweak). No DB migrations.

leo: confirmed — no infra schema changes. Just config + perf tweak. Good to pin.

jen: ok, approving JIT for @sam for a 30m window. Conditions: MFA, deployer role, and follow the rollback checklist posted in #eng-releases.

sam: got it. invoking deploy. running:
```
/deploy svc-routing:v1.12.3 --pin-runtime v2.4.1-quant --canary=5%
```

deploy-bot: @sam requested deploy for svc-routing:v1.12.3. Preconditions: user has deployer role: true. MFA: required. Please confirm MFA code with the bot.

sam: MFA code provided via DM to deploy-bot.

deploy-bot: Canary started: 5% on prod-cluster-a (nodes: 12 -> 1). Observability hooks enabled. ETA ~3m.

maya: Monitor p95 and error rate. Rollback if: p95 > 200ms sustained 5m OR error rate > 0.5% for 5m. Also watch KV cache fill.

sam: canary looks clean at +10m. p95 stable, errors 0.1%. Ramping to 50% now.

deploy-bot: Ramping: 50% -> 100% (progressing).

sam: 100% done. Deploy succeeded across 12 nodes. Version pinned to runtime v2.4.1-quant.

deploy-bot: Final state: SUCCESS. To rollback run:
```
/rollback svc-routing --to ab12f3c
```

leo: reminder: rotate the temporary deploy key and audit the JIT grant after the window closes.

jen: noted, I'll run the post-release audit tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:

sam: all good from ops side, no anomalies. Will rotate keys and close the JIT at 03:35 UTC. Thanks all.
